name: arknights-spine-auto-studio
description: Arknights Spine Auto-Studio: natural language to Arknights character animation (GIF/MP4) via Spine 3.8 + headless Chrome, zero dependencies

scripts.fetch:prts: node src/pipeline.mjs fetch --source prts --character 阿米娅
scripts.list:skins: node src/pipeline.mjs fetch --source prts --character 阿米娅 --list-skins
scripts.run: node src/pipeline.mjs run --prompt "先睡觉，然后起来跑步，最后累贴下" --skel assets/amiya/amiya.skel --mock
scripts.run:prts: node src/pipeline.mjs run --source prts --character 阿米娅 --prompt "睡觉，然后起来跑步" --mock
scripts.run:hi: node src/pipeline.mjs run --prompt "睡觉，然后起来挥手" --skel assets/amiya/amiya.skel --mock --upscale 2 --sr
scripts.test: node test/skel-roundtrip.mjs && node test/codecs.mjs && node test/align.mjs && node test/upscale.mjs && node test/compare.mjs && node test/zip.mjs && node test/prts.mjs && node test/gif-transparency.mjs
